app.name: EmberLine
app.summary: A workspace app where teams turn a prototype into an event model, review and discuss slices, track build status, and manage their account, members, plan and integrations.

screens.name: Board
screens.summary: Event model board with screens, business outcomes and slices for the open project.

screens.name: Projects
screens.summary: List of projects with options to create, open or delete them.

screens.name: Build
screens.summary: Build queue sending ready slices to Claude Code and showing activity and checks.

screens.name: Inbox
screens.summary: Notifications list with unread count.

screens.name: Profile
screens.summary: The user's personal details.

screens.name: Password and security
screens.summary: Change password, two-step verification, sessions and connected sign-ins.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.summary: Notification channel preferences.

screens.name: Workspace settings
screens.summary: Workspace details, email-domain joining and danger zone.

screens.name: Members
screens.summary: Seats, members, roles and invites.

screens.name: Plan and billing
screens.summary: Current plan, plans to choose from and payment method.

screens.name: Integrations
screens.summary: Connected tools and SAML single sign-on setup.

screens.name: Sign in
screens.summary: Email and password or provider sign-in form.

screens.name: Create your account
screens.summary: Account registration form.

screens.name: Check your email
screens.summary: Enter the verification code, or resend it.

screens.name: Reset your password
screens.summary: Request a password reset link.

screens.name: Reset link sent
screens.summary: Confirmation that a reset link was emailed.

screens.name: Set a new password
screens.summary: Choose a new password from the reset link.

screens.name: Sign in with SSO
screens.summary: Sign in through the company identity provider.

screens.name: Invite
screens.summary: Invite details for a signed-in user with option to accept.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.summary: Onboarding: name the workspace, pick a role and invite the team.

screens.name: Slice page
screens.summary: One slice in detail with editing, owner and review controls.

screens.name: Scenario screenshot dialog
screens.summary: Claude-drawn screen for a scenario.

screens.name: Discussion drawer
screens.summary: Threads, replies, suggestions and activity on the model.

screens.name: Share dialog
screens.summary: Manage who can access the project.

screens.name: Features dialog
screens.summary: Rename, describe, own, merge and remove the app's features; review a proposal before using it.

features.name: Accounts & sign-in
features.summary: Sign-up, email codes, sign-in (password, GitHub, Google, SSO), password reset and account security.

features.name: Workspace & members
features.summary: The workspace, its settings, members, invites and roles.

features.name: Plan, billing & integrations
features.summary: Plans, payment, usage and connected tools.

features.name: Projects & modeling
features.summary: Projects, prototypes, deriving, the board, importing and exporting the model.

features.name: Features & boundaries
features.summary: Splitting the model into features, owners, scoped derives, boundaries and feature exports.

features.name: Specs & review
features.summary: Slice detail, scenarios, owners and spec review.

features.name: Discussion & notifications
features.summary: Comment threads, mentions, the inbox and notifications.

features.name: Build
features.summary: Sending slices to the coding agent and tracking them to a merged pull request.
